_about: How each agent takes an INITIAL prompt on its command line, read from each CLI's own --help (2026-10-02). positional: `agent [flags] PROMPT`; dashdash: `agent [flags] -- PROMPT` (devin); flag: `agent [flags] FLAG PROMPT`. Add yours in ~/.config/kittymux/prompt.json (same shape). An agent not listed cannot be fanned out to.
